changeSet.author: manual
changeSet.sql: UPDATE fonction f SET libelle = trim(regexp_replace(f.libelle, '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')), last_modified_by = 'system', last_modified_date = now() WHERE f.libelle <> trim(regexp_replace(f.libelle, '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fonction autre WHERE autre.id <> f.id AND autre.libelle = trim(regexp_replace(f.libelle, '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')) )
